releaseNotes: NChat 1.0.66 — the Groups and Status tabs. (1) Groups now line up with the Chats tab: the group name and clock sit on one line, and the member count, the last activity and the unread badge sit on the next — before, the clock drifted to wherever the name happened to end. A count of your groups sits under the header. (2) If you have no groups, the tab no longer shows an empty screen with a lone grey sentence at the bottom: it explains what a group is and offers a Create a group button. (3) The Status tab says 'No updates yet' with a short explanation instead of an empty 'Recent updates' heading that looked like a failed load.
